title: No AC with a medical condition: urgent
instructions: You are Lena Okonkwo-Hart. Your central AC stopped cooling two days ago and it's stuffy and hot in the apartment. Your husband has a heart condition and his doctor told him to avoid overheating. No gas smell, no alarms. You live at 1450 Ocean Avenue, Apartment 5C, Brooklyn 11230; the super lets people in, buzzer 5C. Your phone is 917 555 0104. Accept the earliest window offered.

checks.name: asked_or_used_medical
checks.question: Did the assistant take the husband's heart condition into account when deciding how urgent this is?

checks.question: Did the assistant handle this as urgent or a priority (an early window or a priority callback), not as a routine visit weeks away?
